Cure All: Removes Poison, Disease, and heals 3d6 damage to all body areas.
Dust of Vanishing: Causes what it is used on to remain invisible so long as no strong wind blows the dust off or sudden movements shake it off.
Fairy Dust: Allows one being to fly for the duration.
Snake Oil: The drinker breaks out in a sweat that is oily. That sweat makes the surface of the being`s body more and more slippery until they cannot stand or even wear certain articles of clothing. Effect takes 10-40 seconds to fully manifest.
Dragon`s Breath: Does 1d4 (cold), 1d6 (fire), 1d8 (electricity) or 1d10 (acid) per Title of the invoker in a breath cone of 2` long and 1` radius at the base per Class Title of the breather. After the imbiber breathes 3 times the effect ends.
Cup of Confusion: Causes auditory hallucinations with feelings of euphoria, and a 20% chance of visual hallucinations. Grants +3 to STR and VIT. -3 to all Mental Attributes. A very high pain threshold is granted reducing all damage occurrences by 2 points. Lie skill is reduced by 50%.
Earthen Stout: Grants +30% to Poison and Disease Resistance, new resistances if currently inflicted. Immune to effects which halt or alter movement and effects which cause sleep or drowsiness.
Gout Soup: Grants +20% Disease Resistance, +1 Vitality, reduction of fever, swelling, and pain, +1d4+1 Endurance. Has very high pain threshold, reducing all damage by 2 points per occurrences.
Healer`s Balm: Heals 4d6+4 damage to all body areas.
Herb-Soaked Bandages: Each strip heals 1d4+1 if the wound is fresh (binding) and an additional 3d4+3 from the herbal infusion. It will also cure gangrene and blood poisoning if it is that body area.
Infused Fruit: Grants +1d4 to all physical Attributes. +20 Endurance. Immune to fear (and any control which would make someone run away). Immune to Shock. Immune to fatigue. Also counts as a full day`s food and drink.
Mystic Marvel: Grants +1d4+1 Intelligence, +1d4+1 Aura, +(1-2) Will Force, +1d4+1 Aura Control, and Improved Telepathy.
Planewalker`s Balm: Grants Immunity to Cold/Heat/Electricity/Acid/Pressure and gains magical flight.
Rheumatic Oil: Reduces joint pain, and makes joints work more effectively. +1 temporary Agility, +10% to skills that use Agility. +10% to Agility saves.
Undead Paste: Can Life Sense up to 60`. Immune to the draining, disease, and/or poison effects of all Undead. Cannot be sensed by undead (those with physical eyes can still see them). All undead must make a Control Resistance to approach within 20`. Even if the Control Resistance is made, they must make another to attack. All undead compulsions are suppressed by any undead within 100` of the protected individual.
